     // Helper function to safely parse and split range strings (e.g., "date1 to date2" or "date1 - date2")
     function parseDateString(text) {
         // Split by common range indicators if present
         const parts = text.split(/\s+(?:to|-)\s+/i);
         return parts.map(p => new Date(p.trim()));
     }

     // --- Basic Date & Time Formatting ---
     function formatBasicDatesAndTimes() {
         var eventDates = document.querySelectorAll('.piecal_date-only:not([data-formatted])');
         eventDates.forEach(function(element) {
             var targetElement = element.childElementCount > 0 ? element.children[0] : element;
             var dates = parseDateString(targetElement.textContent);

             // Check if all parsed dates are valid
             if (dates.length > 0 && dates.every(d => !isNaN(d))) {
                 var options = { year: 'numeric', month: 'long', day: 'numeric' };

                 // Format each date and join them with a dash if it's a range
                 targetElement.textContent = dates.map(d => d.toLocaleDateString(undefined, options)).join(' - ');
                 element.setAttribute('data-formatted', 'true');
             }
         });

         var eventTimes = document.querySelectorAll('.piecal_time-only:not([data-formatted])');
         eventTimes.forEach(function(element) {
             var targetElement = element.childElementCount > 0 ? element.children[0] : element;
             var dates = parseDateString(targetElement.textContent);

             if (dates.length > 0 && dates.every(d => !isNaN(d))) {
                 var options = { hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit' };
                 targetElement.textContent = dates.map(d => d.toLocaleTimeString(undefined, options)).join(' - ');
                 element.setAttribute('data-formatted', 'true');
             }
         });
     }

     // --- Specific Month-Only Formatting ---
     function formatMonthOnly() {
         var monthElements = document.querySelectorAll('.piecal_short_month:not([data-formatted]), .piecal_long_month:not([data-formatted]), .piecal_month_number:not([data-formatted])');

         monthElements.forEach(function(element) {
             var targetElement = element.childElementCount > 0 ? element.children[0] : element;
             var dates = parseDateString(targetElement.textContent);

             if (dates.length > 0 && dates.every(d => !isNaN(d))) {
                 let formattedDates = dates.map(date => {
                     if (element.classList.contains('piecal_short_month')) {
                         return date.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: 'short' }).toUpperCase();
                     } else if (element.classList.contains('piecal_long_month')) {
                         return date.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: 'long' });
                     } else if (element.classList.contains('piecal_month_number')) {
                         return date.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: '2-digit' });
                     }
                     return '';
                 });

                 // De-duplicate months if it's a multi-day event in the same month
                 const uniqueMonths = [...new Set(formattedDates)];
                 targetElement.textContent = uniqueMonths.join(' - ');
                 element.setAttribute('data-formatted', 'true');
             }
         });
     }

     // --- Specific Day-Only Formatting ---
     function formatDayOnly() {
         var dayElements = document.querySelectorAll('.piecal_day_number:not([data-formatted])');

         dayElements.forEach(function(element) {
             var targetElement = element.childElementCount > 0 ? element.children[0] : element;
             var dates = parseDateString(targetElement.textContent);

             if (dates.length > 0 && dates.every(d => !isNaN(d))) {
                 targetElement.textContent = dates.map(d => d.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { day: '2-digit' })).join(' - ');
                 element.setAttribute('data-formatted', 'true');
             }
         });
     }

     // --- Inline Formatting ---
     function formatPieCalendarDates() {
         const complexEvents = document.querySelectorAll('.piecal_inline:not([data-formatted])');

         complexEvents.forEach(function(element) {
             const targetElement = element.childElementCount > 0 ? element.children[0] : element;

             if (targetElement && targetElement.textContent.trim() !== '') {
                 const dates = parseDateString(targetElement.textContent);

                 if (dates.length > 0 && dates.every(d => !isNaN(d.getTime()))) {

                     let strings = dates.map(date => {
                         const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
                         const day = date.getDate();
                         const year = date.getFullYear();

                         let hours = date.getHours();
                         const minutes = date.getMinutes();
                         const ampm = hours >= 12 ? 'pm' : 'am';
                         hours = hours % 12;
                         hours = hours ? hours : 12;
                         const minutesStr = minutes < 10 ? '0' + minutes : minutes;

                         return `${month}/${day}/${year} ${hours}:${minutesStr} ${ampm}`;
                     });

                     targetElement.textContent = strings.join(' - ');
                     element.setAttribute('data-formatted', 'true');
                 }
             }
         });
     }

     // Run functions
     function runAllFormatters() {
         formatBasicDatesAndTimes();
         formatMonthOnly();
         formatDayOnly();
         formatPieCalendarDates();
     }

     // Initial run + DOM Observer for query loops / AJAX loads
     document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
         runAllFormatters();

         const observer = new MutationObserver((mutationsList) => {
             for (const mutation of mutationsList) {
                 if (mutation.type === 'childList' && mutation.addedNodes.length > 0) {
                     runAllFormatters();
                     break;
                 }
             }
         });

         observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
     });

 })();

K2 Space, a Torrance, California company, is developing a low-cost, high-capability satellite platform capable of carrying large payloads and operating in various orbits, including low Earth orbit (LEO), medium Earth orbit (MEO), geosynchronous orbit (GEO) and cislunar space.</p>
<p><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" class="size-full wp-image-2365 aligncenter" src="https://spacewerx.us/wp-content/uploads/K2Space_Image_2.jpg" alt="" width="1200" height="675" srcset="https://spacewerx.us/wp-content/uploads/K2Space_Image_2.jpg 1200w, https://spacewerx.us/wp-content/uploads/K2Space_Image_2-300x169.jpg 300w, https://spacewerx.us/wp-content/uploads/K2Space_Image_2-1024x576.jpg 1024w, https://spacewerx.us/wp-content/uploads/K2Space_Image_2-768x432.jpg 768w, https://spacewerx.us/wp-content/uploads/K2Space_Image_2-480x270.jpg 480w, https://spacewerx.us/wp-content/uploads/K2Space_Image_2-640x360.jpg 640w, https://spacewerx.us/wp-content/uploads/K2Space_Image_2-720x405.jpg 720w, https://spacewerx.us/wp-content/uploads/K2Space_Image_2-960x540.jpg 960w, https://spacewerx.us/wp-content/uploads/K2Space_Image_2-1168x657.jpg 1168w" sizes="auto, (max-width: 1200px) 100vw, 1200px"></p>
<p>The K2 satellite bus delivers 10 times more power than other low-cost buses in its class and boasts a large payload deck. Its multi-orbit capability and high launch density, with up to 10 satellites per launch, support diverse missions and rapid constellation deployment. With the advent of more powerful launch vehicles, K2 went against the grain, using heavier, inexpensive materials that could reduce costs by 90 percent.</p>
<p>This Success Story, which was first published in the AFWERX-SpaceWERX FY2024 Annual Report, has been updated since its initial release.</p>
<p> </p>
<p><strong>K2 Space’s SBIR/STTR Journey</strong></p>
<p><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" class="size-full wp-image-2364 aligncenter" src="https://spacewerx.us/wp-content/uploads/K2Space_Image_1.jpg" alt="" width="1200" height="675" srcset="https://spacewerx.us/wp-content/uploads/K2Space_Image_1.jpg 1200w, https://spacewerx.us/wp-content/uploads/K2Space_Image_1-300x169.jpg 300w, https://spacewerx.us/wp-content/uploads/K2Space_Image_1-1024x576.jpg 1024w, https://spacewerx.us/wp-content/uploads/K2Space_Image_1-768x432.jpg 768w, https://spacewerx.us/wp-content/uploads/K2Space_Image_1-480x270.jpg 480w, https://spacewerx.us/wp-content/uploads/K2Space_Image_1-640x360.jpg 640w, https://spacewerx.us/wp-content/uploads/K2Space_Image_1-720x405.jpg 720w, https://spacewerx.us/wp-content/uploads/K2Space_Image_1-960x540.jpg 960w, https://spacewerx.us/wp-content/uploads/K2Space_Image_1-1168x657.jpg 1168w" sizes="auto, (max-width: 1200px) 100vw, 1200px"></p>
<p>In 2023, K2 Space participated in the Tactically Responsive Space Challenge, an initiative by SpaceWERX and Space Safari aimed at accelerating the development of space technologies. The company successfully competed and was awarded a SBIR contract, demonstrating its innovative approach.</p>
<p>Recognizing the potential of K2 Space’s technology, the DAF also awarded the company multiple Small Business Innovation Research and Small Business Technology Transfer contracts in FY23-24, meant to support its initial early work on its satellite technology.</p>
<p>Then, as FY24 drew to a close, K2 Space was awarded a $60 million STRATFI contract by SpaceWERX and Space Force, Air Force Research Laboratory and the Pentagon’s Space Test Program, reaching this milestone at blazing speed, just halfway through their period of performance.</p>
<p>The Gravitas mission has also received support from the Department of War’s Space Development Agency, Space Force’s Space Domain Awareness and Combat Power Program Executive Office, Space Warfighting Acquisition Delta and National Space Test and Training Complex.</p>
<p>The Gravitas flight is slated for March 2026, marking the first launch of the company’s mega-class satellite, powered by a 20-kilowatt Hall-effect thruster, into medium orbit. K2 tested its electric propulsion system at its Torrance facility earlier this year.</p>
<p>Consisting of SBIR and other government funds, as well as private capital, the STRATFI will support the completion of K2’s mega-class satellite bus. The project will include designing and building payload interfaces, integrating payloads, launch, and operation for a minimum of 18 months after launch.</p>
<p><img decoding="async" loading="lazy" class="size-full wp-image-2366 aligncenter" src="https://spacewerx.us/wp-content/uploads/K2Space_Image_3.jpg" alt="" width="1200" height="829" srcset="https://spacewerx.us/wp-content/uploads/K2Space_Image_3.jpg 1200w, https://spacewerx.us/wp-content/uploads/K2Space_Image_3-300x207.jpg 300w, https://spacewerx.us/wp-content/uploads/K2Space_Image_3-1024x707.jpg 1024w, https://spacewerx.us/wp-content/uploads/K2Space_Image_3-768x531.jpg 768w, https://spacewerx.us/wp-content/uploads/K2Space_Image_3-480x332.jpg 480w, https://spacewerx.us/wp-content/uploads/K2Space_Image_3-640x442.jpg 640w, https://spacewerx.us/wp-content/uploads/K2Space_Image_3-720x497.jpg 720w, https://spacewerx.us/wp-content/uploads/K2Space_Image_3-960x663.jpg 960w, https://spacewerx.us/wp-content/uploads/K2Space_Image_3-1168x807.jpg 1168w" sizes="auto, (max-width: 1200px) 100vw, 1200px"></p>
<p>In July, K2 announced it had successfully demonstrated several of its in-house satellite components in space. These critical components included a flight computer, microcontroller core board, motor controller and reaction wheel. Successful validation of these components should reduce the technical risks for the DAF-supported Gravitas mission, K2 officials said.</p>
<p>In October, K2 Space said it plans to launch three satellites into orbit in 2027 using a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket. Dubbed Trinity, the launch will include multiple deployments in which the satellites will operate at low, medium and geostationary transfer orbits.</p>
